resources.string: Open Bounce to unlock it. No messages arrive until you do.
Enter your recovery code to open Bounce again. You can choose a new password, or leave it empty to have none.
This device no longer holds the key to Bounce\'s data. That happens when the app\'s data is moved or restored onto another device. Enter your recovery code to open Bounce again.
The two passwords are not the same.
I don\'t have a recovery code
That code has a typing mistake in it. Check it against the one you wrote down.
That is not the recovery code for this install. Only the last code created for it works.
The data Bounce keeps on this device can be opened again. From now on Bounce asks for your new password when it starts.
The data Bounce keeps on this device can be opened again. No password is set.
How this install is protected now, and whether your recovery code still works, is shown under Security in the settings.
Without a recovery code, the data Bounce keeps on this device cannot be opened.
No recovery code was ever created for this install. Without one, the data Bounce keeps on this device cannot be opened.
The file that holds the key to Bounce\'s data is missing from this device, and without it the data cannot be opened.
The file that holds the key to Bounce\'s data is damaged, and without it the data cannot be opened.
Resetting deletes the messages, files, contacts and identity Bounce keeps on this device, and starts over as a new install. Your other devices are not changed.
Everything Bounce keeps on this device will be deleted, and it cannot be brought back.
Bounce can\'t reach this device\'s keystore
The key to Bounce\'s data is kept in this device\'s keystore, which did not answer. Try again, and restart the device if it keeps happening.
Protected by this device and your password

Everything Bounce stores on this device is encrypted with a key kept in the device\'s keystore, which other apps and a copy of the app\'s data cannot use. A password adds less here than on a computer: it protects the data only while Bounce is locked, which is from when the device or Bounce restarts until you type it.
A recovery code can be created once a password is set.

Bounce asks for this password every time it starts. After the device restarts, or Android restarts Bounce in the background, no messages arrive until you open Bounce and type it. Bounce also has to stay running to receive messages, because it cannot be woken on a schedule with nobody there to unlock it.\n\nIf you forget the password and have no recovery code, the data Bounce keeps on this device cannot be opened.
The two passwords are not the same.
Bounce asks for your password from the next start on.
Bounce asks for your password from the next start on. That start also finishes protecting the data already on this device, so restart Bounce when you can.
Bounce asks for your new password from the next start on.
Bounce will open without asking for a password, with its data protected by this device alone.
Nothing will protect the data Bounce keeps on this device, and your recovery code will stop working.
A recovery code opens Bounce if you forget your password, or if this device loses the key to Bounce\'s data. It is shown once, to be written down and kept somewhere safe.
The code you have now will stop working.
Write this code down and keep it somewhere safe. It is not shown again, and anyone who has it and this device can open your messages.
This device\'s keystore could not be reached. Try again.
This device no longer holds the key to Bounce\'s data.
Bounce has to be restarted before a password can be set again.
